As substance use continues to hurt our loved ones, we have to both improve addiction treatment and stop illicit drugs from entering our country and communities. 

This strategy is a step in the right direction.

I tested positive for COVID today. I'm experiencing minor, cold-like symptoms and plan to work virtually while quarantining at our home in Denver this week. I encourage all Coloradans to get vaccinated and boosted to protect themselves, their families, and our communities.

Accurate, high quality diagnostic tests are critical to provide the best treatment to patients. @SenatorBurr and I have been working for years to pass the VALID Act to protect public health and accelerate innovation. 

Congress should get this done. https://t.co/hyOs4DSxjr

As families face high prices, it’s unacceptable that Congress’s inaction will end free school meal programs for many kids across Colorado.
 
Now more than ever, we need to help our schools provide students with nutritious food through the next school year. https://t.co/nSPQb4ymti

Relieved to hear that President Biden’s COVID-19 symptoms are mild. I wish @POTUS a speedy recovery.

Get vaccinated and boosted, Colorado: https://t.co/D1wVU25zzo

There are so-called leaders across this country putting themselves between a woman and her right to choose. 

And now they're threatening to prosecute Americans who exercise their right to cross state lines for reproductive health care.

This is literally crazy. https://t.co/2KdY9lkBWp

.@SecVilsack and I just met with Colorado agriculture and nutrition leaders about the challenges Coloradans face — from food insecurity to drought.

The next Farm Bill is around the corner, and I’m committed to ensuring it gives Colorado producers more certainty. https://t.co/eSCXvVcq6W

We have a huge opportunity to pass the Give Kids A Chance Act and provide children battling cancer with lifesaving treatment.
 
We can’t let it pass us by.
https://t.co/4ini2ryoNv

Glad to see a return of the @WhiteHouse Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, & Health.
Last year, in large part due to the #ChildTaxCredit, hunger dropped to its lowest rate in two decades. Bringing it back is a first step to ending child hunger in America. https://t.co/OoRu8EXfCr

We are investing in the health of Southwest Colorado by funding a new substance use disorder treatment center and growing our nursing workforce. 
https://t.co/Y0XbTlz4xP
Happy birthday to a great friend, my former boss, and new dad @SenatorHick. Wishing him and Robin lots of sleep. https://t.co/p7zZXreAww

Our kids are online constantly.

At the same time, they’re getting less sleep, exercise, and in-person interaction. They’re less happy. 

They’re the most connected generation, but they’re also the loneliest.

Vladimir Kara-Murza's only crime was using his voice to oppose Putin's lawless war. He's suffering unjust treatment in prison, and I’m deeply concerned about reports of his condition.

I'm joining my colleagues to urge the Biden administration to use its resources to free him.

Almost 60% of American teens use Snapchat – and now have access to an AI chatbot they didn't ask for. 

Our kids should not be test users for experimental AI tools. We need oversight of these companies and the technology they create. https://t.co/1qESvQ5ime

When I was superintendent, our kids didn’t confront the challenges they face now, like increased gun violence and social media. As a result, they're dealing with a mental health crisis like never before.

Congress must act to support the next generation.
https://t.co/ez82UoEo61

As a former school superintendent, I saw kids unable to stay awake in class because they didn’t have a stable place to sleep the night before.

I'm pleased to see this funding go to @MDHICoC, where they're working to end youth homelessness.

I joined more than 20 colleagues to call for monitored fuel delivery to hospitals and water treatment centers in Gaza. 

We must work with Israel, Egypt, and our UN partners on the ground to protect civilian lives.

SNAP is a critical lifeline for Americans fighting hunger, but participants still can’t use their benefits to buy hot meals.

I’m working across the aisle to fix this outdated provision and ensure families and seniors have access to critical nutrition. https://t.co/CXg2XEyiMc

I introduced legislation to help veterans, who have bravely served our country, and their families access the fertility care they need.

I’m glad @DeptVetAffairs heard this call and acted to support veterans seeking fertility treatment.  https://t.co/OumpyL5A2a

This weekend, leaders gathered in Selma to recognize the 59th anniversary of Bloody Sunday, when John Lewis and brave civil rights marchers faced horrific violence trying to exercise their right to vote. https://t.co/f3VhjJmEe0

✅Over $2M secured for the Rocky Mountain Biological Laboratory and the Gunnison Water treatment plant in Gunnison County.

As Colorado and the West face the worsening effects of climate change, this funding will help meet our state’s changing needs.
https://t.co/JcaxfwynVu

I know personally how important early cancer detection is. That’s why I partnered with @MikeCrapo to introduce the Medicare #MCED Screening Coverage Act. 

Our bipartisan bill will ensure more Americans can access these critical tools. https://t.co/YMwVfpxCdX

On the 59th anniversary of the Voting Rights Act, we honor those who fought tirelessly for this right and commit to continuing our work to ensure every American can freely exercise their right to vote.

I’m honored to receive an "A" on Defend the Vote's 2024 voting rights scorecard.

59 years since the Voting Rights Act was signed into law, we must keep fighting to protect our democracy and ensure every American can freely exercise their right to vote.
https://t.co/JVzf4CR1mV

I know from personal experience – early cancer detection makes all the difference.

Denver Health and Hospitals Authority will receive $500K to improve access to life-saving cancer screenings, especially in Colorado’s underserved communities
https://t.co/4jOs37LWvd
